_comment: Foundry / AI Services account SKU allow-list.
WHY THIS EXISTS: no built-in policy constrains Cognitive Services account
SKUs. Verified 2026-09-25 - neither the 'Cognitive Services' nor the
'Azure Ai Services' built-in category contains a SKU policy.
ALIAS VERIFIED against the live provider:

properties.displayName: Foundry and AI Services accounts must use an approved SKU
properties.description: Denies or audits Microsoft.CognitiveServices accounts created with a SKU outside the approved list. Commitment-tier and reserved account SKUs represent committed spend and are excluded by default.

metadata.description: Audit reports without blocking. Deny blocks the deployment.
Account-level SKU names permitted for Microsoft.CognitiveServices accounts.
